title: 望庐山瀑布
englishTitle: Viewing the Waterfall at Mount Lu
author: Li Bai

translation: The sun illuminates the incense burner peak, producing purple mist
From afar, I see the waterfall hanging before the stream
Its swift current drops three thousand feet straight down
I suspect the Milky Way has fallen from the highest heavens

annotations.香炉: incense burner — a peak at Mount Lu shaped like an incense burner
annotations.紫烟: purple mist — rosy glow at sunrise
annotations.三千尺: three thousand chi — about 1000 meters, an exaggeration for effect
annotations.落九天: falling from the nine heavens — the highest realm

appreciation: Li Bai uses bold exaggeration to describe the waterfall at Mount Lu. The water appears to be hanging before the mountain stream, then rushes down three thousand feet as if the Milky Way itself had fallen from heaven. This poem exemplifies Li Bai's characteristic romantic, imaginative style.
